stem: Which of the following is not a straight chain hydrocarbon? (Four structural formulae. a) \(H_3C-CH_2-CH_2-CH_2-CH_2-CH_3\) drawn with the last carbon bent downward to a terminal \(CH_3\) — a continuous six-carbon chain. b) a central CH carbon bonded to two \(CH_3\) groups and to a \(-CH_2-CH_2-CH_3\) chain (a branched isohexane). c) \(H_3C-CH_2-CH_2-CH_2-CH_2-CH_3\), a continuous chain. d) \(H_3C-CH_2-CH_2-CH_2-CH_3\), a continuous chain drawn bent.)

Which of the following are correct structural isomers of butane? (Four electron-dot/structural formulae labelled (i)-(iv). (i) a straight chain of four carbons H-C-C-C-C-H = n-butane. (ii) a central carbon bonded to three CH3 groups and one H (2-methylpropane / isobutane), drawn with broken spacing. (iii) a chain H-C-C-C-H with a fourth carbon (C-H) branching off the middle carbon = 2-methylpropane / isobutane. (iv) four carbons joined in a closed square ring, each with 2 H = cyclobutane.)

stem: The correct representation of covalent bonding in an oxygen molecule is: (Four Lewis electron-dot diagrams of two overlapping oxygen atoms. a) 6 electrons on each O outside the overlap with 1 shared pair (single bond) in the overlap. b) 5 electrons on each O outside with 1 shared pair in the overlap. c) 2 electrons on each O outside with 3 shared pairs (triple bond) in the overlap. d) 4 electrons (2 lone pairs) on each O outside with 2 shared pairs (double bond) in the overlap.)

stem: The electron dot structure of chlorine molecule is: (Four Lewis electron-dot diagrams of two overlapping chlorine atoms. a) 6 electrons on each Cl outside the overlap with 2 shared pairs (double bond). b) 6 electrons (3 lone pairs) on each Cl outside with 1 shared pair (single bond) in the overlap. c) 5 electrons on each Cl outside with 3 shared pairs (triple bond). d) 4 electrons on each Cl outside with 2 shared pairs (double bond).)
